scenario.input: Synthetic, fully scored single-effort four-model N/S/T schedule; for every model, agent configuration and replica, N=20, S=50, T=30 on R-F and T=100 on R-M and R-S.

checks.focused_ruff: uv run ruff check scripts/analyze_confirmatory.py tests/test_analyze_confirmatory.py: all checks passed
checks.baseline_replay: git show baseline_commit:scripts/analyze_confirmatory.py loaded as a separate module against the same synthetic schedule and evaluations

limits: Every score in the scenario is invented; no provider or judge ran.
Cell medians and ranges use available Q values; an incomplete matrix still has null primary_effects.
critical_failures is null because Q scores alone do not contain independent incident review.
No artifact custody, blind rating, external authentication or confirmatory criterion 4 result is established.
